title: In the AI era, are Software Developers still needed?
description: The new age of software development challenges developers to move beyond just writing code. Instead, they'll address problems through natural language and higher-level concepts, focusing on what’s important for the application rather than specific implementations. This shift could turn developers into architects. #AINativeDeveloper #AINativeDevelopment #SoftwareDevelopment
